units.source_text: 板门的宽度倒着身子正好可以进去。

en.t: The width of the wooden door was just enough for me to slip through sideways.

units.source_text: 我的身体泡在金阁的黑暗中。

en.t: My body was immersed in the darkness of the Golden Pavilion.

units.source_text: 一张不可思议的面孔显露出来，它使我全身战栗。

en.t: An uncanny face appeared, making my whole body shudder.

units.source_text: 却原来是我刚步入金阁时，在火柴亮光的辉映下，

en.t: It turned out that, just as I had stepped into the Golden Pavilion, in the glow of the matchlight,

units.source_text: 我的脸映在陈列金阁模型的玻璃橱的玻璃上。

en.t: my face had been reflected in the glass of the display case holding the model of the Golden Pavilion.
